# CAREER JOURNAL 1.0.2

This patch closes the migration gap in the rolling 24-hour mailbox contract. Every successful host sync now persists its validated all-message, pagination-complete coverage window together with the number of new messages and Jev attempts.

Doctor no longer accepts older success timestamps by themselves. Each selected host mailbox must have current coverage evidence produced by the new importer before email and automation health can pass. This prevents a prefiltered legacy sync from being mistaken for a complete daily review.

Coverage metadata contains no credentials or message bodies.

---

# CAREER JOURNAL 1.0.2 中文说明

这个补丁补上了过去 24 小时全量邮箱流程的迁移缺口。宿主邮箱同步成功后，系统会保存已经核验的完整时间窗、全量邮件和分页完成信息，以及新邮件数与 Jev 实际尝试数。

Doctor 不再只看旧版留下的成功时间。每个已选宿主邮箱必须由新版导入器生成最新覆盖证据，邮箱和自动化检查才能通过。这样，旧版经过关键词预筛的同步不会再被误认为完整检查。

覆盖信息不包含邮箱凭据或邮件正文。
